verdict.reason: The pages say api.blotato.com is not a valid base URL and a DNS error for it means the AI tool guessed wrong, and give the correct URLs.

steps.text: api.blotato.com is not a valid base URL, so if your AI tool reports a DNS error for it, the tool guessed wrong.
For the REST API (direct HTTP, n8n, Make) use https://backend.blotato.com/v2.
For the MCP Server use https://mcp.blotato.com/mcp.
